notes.title: More & Improved Answers
notes.content:
Hey all!

We just wanted to say that we have done some updates to the game!

- We've improved and additional answers to the game!
- We've also added more achievements
- Lastly, as you might have noticed, we have changed the game's logotype and art-work outside the game!

As always, we also would like to thank everyone who continuously gives us feedback!

We appreciate all the feedback we are getting on all our channels (from in-game to DMs) in order to improve the game! Thank you!
